scientific_integrity: The analytical coefficient follows from constant reproduction, exact step reduction, coefficient concentration and Voronoi-cell variation localization. Code checks are finite numerical corroboration, not independent proof.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional fixed finite node sets; nonincreasing decaying continuous strictly positive definite radial profiles; the sharp formula concerns the narrow-kernel limit, not all finite scales nor simultaneous growing node counts or collapsing gaps. Numerical variation estimates are supplementary, and historical priority is not independently confirmed.
title: A universal sharp peaked-kernel variation law for constant-augmented interpolation
